steps.en: Install the library — or clone the repo to work with its recipes
steps.zh: 安装库，或直接 clone 仓库以便用配方

steps.en: Pick one of 200+ task recipes and launch training from its YAML
steps.zh: 挑一份任务配方，用它的 YAML 一键启动训练

steps.en: Runs the whole experiment the YAML declares — model, data, optimizer — saving checkpoints and logs
steps.zh: 按 YAML 声明跑完整个实验，保存检查点与日志

steps.en: Load your trained result or any Hugging Face checkpoint as a ready inference object
steps.zh: 用推理 API 加载训练成果或 HF 预训练权重

value.en: Train, reproduce, and adapt speech models for many tasks on one PyTorch codebase instead of five glued-together repos
value.zh: 在一个 PyTorch 代码库上训练、复现与改造多任务语音模型，不再拼接五个仓库

sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/speechbrain/speechbrain/develop/README.md — Quick Start / Installation ('pip install speechbrain'; 'git clone https://github.com/speechbrain/speechbrain.git')

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/speechbrain/speechbrain/develop/README.md — Training Recipes ('python train.py hparams/train.yaml'; 'over 200 competitive training recipes'; hyperparameters in a YAML, training orchestrated by the Python script)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/speechbrain/speechbrain/develop/README.md — Pretrained Models and Inference ('from speechbrain.inference import EncoderDecoderASR')
